name: tracker-native-alert-host-work
goal: Managed Tracker sessions resolve the active installed CLI for alert and host-work after an upgrade.

evidence: Run 1275 on primary Mac reproduced unavailable in native mode for alert and host-work; removing the inherited executable pin reached both live parsers. The configured tools symlink and pinned binary point to different releases.

The existing managed-worker roundtrip uses a regular harness fixture and does not invoke the installed Tracker shim with the launched environment. Exercise the same lifecycle with a CLI symlink rotated across fixture releases.
